inherited_inputs: D120 conditional P=10552 precision design and norm-97 cofactor separation.
D115 actual P=200 state and CM moment bank and exact harmonic masses.
D109 splitting equation and exact transport matrix constants/slopes.
D116 four coarse coefficients and integral quadratic-section interface.
new_deductions: An integral low-moment solve gives a Schur iteration gaining r+1 pi-digits.
Directed block LU needs 2246 updates on the fixed 174-state graph.
Finite-difference interpolation with eleven guard bits gives exact arbitrary-precision field-valued matrix products.
All 399 actual transport maps are refined on the same Hensel branch to P=10552.
One actual harmonic column, all its 17 CM charts and four coarse coefficients are refined to P=400.

failures: Two target-transport checks mishandled the old infinite-valuation sentinel; finite-modulus overlap comparison corrected.
One dependent lift stage was launched before its predecessor artifact existed; rerun after predecessor completed.
independent_methods: Cross-multiply every normalized transport instead of repeating pi-division and inversion.
Check all fifteen ordinary integer interpolation monomials.
Direct recurrence checks selected original actual moment equations.
Alternate binomial coefficients and Horner evaluation reproduce all 68 actual coarse values.
Verify every inherited hash and every new input receipt and failed source snapshot.

next_bounded_task: Compile and independently validate a faster polynomial transport backend, then complete all sixteen actual P=400 columns and recompute residue-frame quadrics before a target-size lift.
